Cyber Incident response
Need help from our investigation and response team?
CyberCX has the region’s largest and most advanced investigation and response practice. Our dedicated team of specialists have helped hundreds of organisations across Australia and New Zealand on the most sensitive and complex cyber security incidents.
We provide unmatched industry knowledge, understanding of the local threat landscape, and deep expertise across all stages of the breach response cycle.
Support for individuals
Our team is setup to provide digital forensic investigations and cyber breach response services to businesses, governments and other organisations.
If you are contacting us in relation to a personal matter, we recommend that you visit the
Australian Cyber Security Centre
for assistance.
Support for businesses and organisations
If you require our assistance, please complete the enquiry form below.
If you currently have a retainer for DFIR services with CyberCX, please contact us through the dedicated escalation process as defined in your retainer documentation for the quickest response.
